properties.notes: Hospital operations would need to be maintained. The site includes listed buildings. The site is partially greenfield and partially brownfield (as shown on the site location plan). The land area in hectares (and resulting capacity estimate) given relates to the brownfield part of the site only.. The site is allocated for a range of uses (including housing and student accommodation) in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013 post NPPF.
properties.site-address: Warneford Hospital, Warneford Lane, Oxford, OX3 7JX
